blocks.directed: Karmic impressions are understood as possessing the potential to produce further experience.

blocks.text: A condition capable of giving rise to future results.

blocks.text: And a seed doesn’t need to be producing a plant right now to possess that potential.
blocks.directed: And a seed doesn’t need to be producing a plant right now to possess that potential.

blocks.text: Then, under appropriate conditions, it gives rise to another manifestation.

blocks.directed: Similarly, the tantric account treats certain bonds as retaining the capacity to generate further conditioned existence.

blocks.text: Now Abhinavagupta says the ritual destroys:
blocks.directed: [short pause] Now Abhinavagupta says the ritual destroys:

blocks.text: The capacity to produce one’s own effect.
blocks.directed: The capacity to produce one’s own effect.

blocks.text: The capacity to generate the corresponding result.
blocks.directed: The capacity to generate the corresponding result.

blocks.text: Now that’s a remarkably precise metaphysical idea.
blocks.directed: Now that’s a remarkably precise metaphysical idea.

blocks.text: The rite isn’t merely understood to remove one particular painful experience.
blocks.directed: The rite isn’t merely understood to remove one particular painful experience.

blocks.text: It’s directed toward the very capacity of the remaining karmic seeds to bring about further bondage.
blocks.directed: It’s directed toward the very capacity of the remaining karmic seeds to bring about further bondage.

blocks.text: And here the traditional image becomes clear.
blocks.directed: And here the traditional image becomes clear.

blocks.text: A seed whose productive capacity has been destroyed no longer gives rise to the corresponding plant.
blocks.directed: A seed whose productive capacity has been destroyed no longer gives rise to the corresponding plant.

blocks.text: Because even stationary beings are said to be eligible for initiation.
blocks.directed: Because even stationary beings are said to be eligible for initiation.

blocks.text: Now, sthāvara is a fascinating word.
blocks.directed: Now, sthāvara is a fascinating word.

blocks.text: From the root associated with standing or remaining stationary.
blocks.directed: From the root associated with standing or remaining stationary.

blocks.text: It can refer to immobile beings, especially plants and trees.
blocks.directed: It can refer to immobile beings, especially plants and trees.

blocks.text: But the philosophical implication is rather important.
blocks.directed: But the philosophical implication is rather important.

blocks.text: Because we’re no longer restricting the possibility of divine participation to beings possessing sophisticated conceptual understanding.
blocks.directed: Because we’re no longer restricting the possibility of divine participation to beings possessing sophisticated conceptual understanding.

blocks.text: Not every manifestation possesses the same faculties.
blocks.directed: Not every manifestation possesses the same faculties.

blocks.text: Not every subject has the same capacity for articulation and understanding.
blocks.directed: Not every subject has the same capacity for articulation and understanding.

blocks.text: But all manifestations are grounded in Śiva.
blocks.directed: But all manifestations are grounded in Śiva.

blocks.text: And the tradition’s claim that even stationary beings may be initiated follows from this much broader understanding of conscious manifestation.
blocks.directed: And the tradition’s claim that even stationary beings may be initiated follows from this much broader understanding of conscious manifestation.

blocks.text: Now, that isn’t biological evidence that plants possess the same subjective experiences as human beings.
blocks.directed: Now, that isn’t biological evidence that plants possess the same subjective experiences as human beings.

blocks.text: Nor does the Sanskrit establish a modern scientific theory of plant consciousness.
blocks.directed: Nor does the Sanskrit establish a modern scientific theory of plant consciousness.

blocks.text: But within Trika metaphysics, the eligibility of stationary beings for initiation underscores a radical claim:
blocks.directed: [short pause] But within Trika metaphysics, the eligibility of stationary beings for initiation underscores a radical claim:

blocks.text: The divine reality isn’t confined to intellectually sophisticated human subjects.
blocks.directed: The divine reality isn’t confined to intellectually sophisticated human subjects.

blocks.text: We’ve been studying classifications of subjects for several chapters.
blocks.directed: We’ve been studying classifications of subjects for several chapters.

blocks.text: Here the scope of ritual grace extends to beings incapable of undertaking the normal practices themselves.
blocks.directed: Here the scope of ritual grace extends to beings incapable of undertaking the normal practices themselves.

blocks.text: And then Abhinavagupta gives us one final visualisation.
blocks.directed: And then Abhinavagupta gives us one final visualisation.

Now the guru contemplates the disciple within:
blocks.directed:

Now the guru contemplates the disciple within:

blocks.text: The realm or city of wind.

blocks.text: And the disciple is imagined as:
blocks.directed: [short pause] And the disciple is imagined as:

blocks.directed: And the text even refers to lightness as observed through a balance.

blocks.text: Now, you might imagine the initiate literally becoming weightless.

blocks.text: And the historical ritual does include a striking claim concerning the disciple’s lightness.
blocks.directed: And the historical ritual does include a striking claim concerning the disciple’s lightness.

blocks.text: But there’s no reliable basis for treating such a visualisation as a method of physically reducing someone’s mass or producing levitation.

blocks.text: What matters to our interpretation is that lightness becomes the ritual sign associated with the removal of a burdening condition.
blocks.directed: What matters to our interpretation is that lightness becomes the ritual sign associated with the removal of a burdening condition.

blocks.text: The disciple is contemplated as no longer held in the previous configuration of bondage.
blocks.directed: The disciple is contemplated as no longer held in the previous configuration of bondage.

blocks.text: And in the chapter’s condensed presentation, this is the final visualisation.
blocks.directed: And in the chapter’s condensed presentation, this is the final visualisation.

blocks.directed: Now think about the full sequence we’ve just encountered.

blocks.directed: The destruction of latent generative power.
